title: Vader is the Death Star
description: Vader is the Death Star in this RETURN OF THE JEDI concept poster (front) by R. Harris after Kazuhiko Sano. The JEDI poster collage by Larry Noble (back) was used as a cover for the second issue of VIDEO AND ARCADE GAMES magazine. Noble is no stranger to the STAR WARS universe (cards 66, 175) and has won numerous awards from the Society of Illustrators.
